visual.title: Height is sine, width is cosine
visual.caption: The unit circle makes the definitions visible. The horizontal coordinate of P is cos θ and the vertical coordinate is sin θ. The graph below plots those same two coordinates against the angle, so the circle point and the two curves always agree.

predict.question: At θ = 30°, which coordinate of P is 1/2?
predict.explain: A 30° angle gives the point (√3/2, 1/2). The vertical coordinate is sin 30° = 1/2, while the horizontal coordinate is cos 30° = √3/2. The readout reports both from the same point.
